name: 43-sazae-oni
description: Sazae-oni: a big spiky khaki turban sea-snail shell with spines around its whorls, a red-skinned oni demon face with small horns and a toothy grin leaning out of the shell's opening. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Sitting in place: the red demon leans out of its shell grinning, mouth open, then shrinks back into the shell. The shell stays still. Same facing, same size. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.
